evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Zidek et al., 2015.

evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Zidek et al., 2015.

claim: Endogenous LIP levels increase upon ageing in pre-adipocytes and in isolated fat cells from rats.
source: Furthermore, the Kirkland lab has shown that endogenous LIP levels increase upon ageing in pre-adipocytes and in isolated fat cells from rats which correlated with reduced C/EBPα expression and reduced differentiation potential of the pre-adipocytes and that overexpression of LIP in preadipocytes from young rats impaired adipogenesis (Karagiannides et al., 2001).
evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Karagiannides et al., 2001.

claim: Pharmacological activation of PPARγ by thiazolidines stimulates adipocyte differentiation.
source: Pharmacological activation of PPARγ by thiazolidines similarly to the CebpbΔuORF mutation stimulates adipocyte differentiation, results in fat storage in hyperplastic adipocytes and in a shift to fat storage in the subcutaneous compartment, resulting in improved metabolic health (Adams et al., 1997; Fujiwara et al., 1988; McLaughlin et al., 2010; Okuno et al., 1998).
evidence: This statement is supported by citations to Adams et al., 1997, Fujiwara et al., 1988, McLaughlin et al., 2010, and Okuno et al., 1998.

claim: The slight increase in PPARγ expression together with the increased LAP function might be sufficient for the observed adipocyte hyperplasia in female CebpbΔuORF mice on HFD.
source: Probably, the slight increase in PPARγ expression together with the increased LAP function might be sufficient for the observed adipocyte hyperplasia in female CebpbΔuORF mice on HFD, which however, seems to be less pronounced compared to HFD fed CebpbΔuORF males.
evidence: This is a speculative explanation for the observed phenotype.

claim: The downregulation of fatty acid synthetase (FAS) mRNA levels in wt mice upon HFD seems to be independent from the expression of the adipogenic transcription factors tested.
source: The downregulation of fatty acid synthetase (FAS) mRNA levels that we observe in wt mice upon HFD seems to be independent from the expression of the adipogenic transcription factors tested because at least in females these regulatory events were uncoupled and might be due to other effects of HFD feeding.
evidence: This is an interpretation of the experimental findings.

claim: In CebpbΔuORF females the protein expression of FAS on HFD does not correspond to the FAS mRNA levels.
source: Furthermore, in CebpbΔuORF females the protein expression of FAS on HFD does not correspond to the FAS mRNA levels, it is efficiently reduced despite almost completely maintained mRNA levels suggesting interfering, post-transcriptional effects.
evidence: This is a summary of the experimental findings presented in the manuscript.

claim: Pharmacological reduction of LIP expression is proposed as an approach to switch the unhealthy metabolic phenotype of obese individuals into a healthy obese phenotype.
source: Taken together, our data propose pharmacological reduction of LIP expression as an approach to switch the unhealthy metabolic phenotype of obese individuals into a healthy obese phenotype to prevent the development of metabolic disease (possibly together with pharmacologic PPARγ activation).
evidence: This is a speculative proposal based on the findings of the study.

claim: A search for drugs that inhibit LIP expression is feasible through the identification of drugs that inhibit LIP expression similar to mTORC1-inhibition.

evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Zaini et al., 2017.

claim: Adevovir dipivoxil was identified as an inhibitor of LIP expression.
source: One drug that we identified as an inhibitor of LIP expression, the antiviral drug adevovir dipivoxil (Zaini et al., 2017), was recently tested on female wt mice upon ND and HFD feeding (Bitto et al., 2021).
evidence: This statement is supported by citations to Zaini et al., 2017 and Bitto et al., 2021.

claim: Adevovir is effective in increasing the LAP/LIP isoform ratio in vivo.
source: This study showed that adevovir is effective in increasing the LAP/LIP isoform ratio also in vivo (although in the mice LIP expression was not affected but rather LAP expression was increased), which resulted in increased C/EBPβ target gene activation and increased expression of β-oxidation genes in the liver similar to what we observed in the CebpbΔuORF mice (Zidek et al., 2015).
evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Bitto et al., 2021 (implied from context).

evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Bitto et al., 2021 (implied from context).

claim: The increased C/EBPβ function in CebpbΔuORF mice has the potential to extend the healthspan.
source: Since the increased C/EBPβ function in CebpbΔuORF mice also has the potential to extend the healthspan (Müller et al., 2018), therapeutic interference with the C/EBPβ isoform ratio may represent a promising strategy to attenuate the metabolic disturbances not only associated with overnutrition but also with ageing.
evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Müller et al., 2018.
